incidents.name: PresaleV5 slot0 pricing manipulation
incidents.notes: PresaleV5.buyWithEth() priced the sale token from the current slot0 of a Uniswap V3 pool with no TWAP or independent check, so a flash-loaned sale into that pool let the attacker buy presale tokens at a manipulated discount and sell them straight back, repeated within one transaction.

sources.ref: onchain review: presale proxy 0x9a15bb3A8feC8d0d810691BafE36F6e5D42360f7 created 2024-10-09T13:42:11Z by 0x26c6b1cd843c8e5aa1c9958df95d85424d390928, not the attack-tx sender 0x3a7e13dacccd3de56b8186987f348bfd21dc4ec5; six EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last at block 21994149 on 2025-03-07T09:36:47Z installing 0x09c135aacd4a82b08890e930dfdc3143b4578d45 (the implementation the PoC names), so the executing code was 164.8 days old. 2.3157 ETH x $4,209.45 at the incident timestamp (DefiLlama) = $9,748.
